name: Promix Unflavored Grass Fed Whey Isolate
whyItWorks: Contains just two ingredients: native cold-filtered grass-fed whey isolate and 0.75% sunflower lecithin for mixing. Completely devoid of gums, emulsifiers, artificial flavors, stevia, and lactose.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Shake 1 scoop with cool water or lactose-free milk in a blender bottle for 15 seconds.
